## Description

A flattened, lance-shaped haptorid (50–100 × 10–25 µm) with extrusomes in its oral slit: it hunts
ciliates, especially hypotrichs such as *Euplotes* (the *Litonotus*–*Euplotes* pair is a laboratory
predator–prey system).

## In the simulation

<!-- GENERATED:presence -->
Drops: `pond` (weight 0.15), `puddle` (weight 0.15); 2 individuals in a reference drop at weight 1.
<!-- /GENERATED -->

A raptorial hunter with [toxicysts](../../mechanics/feeding-and-phagocytosis.md) on the edge of the oral slit that
paralyse *Euplotes* before swallowing it; the body narrows into a "neck" towards the anterior pole.
Reach and paralysis duration estimated.
